surface: ICLR2027 experimental-section fragment, single column, unchanged 5.5-inch text width and template fonts/margins; up to 10 pages including standalone references.
palette: Existing blue #28679C and orange #B86B2D; pale gradients #ADC8E2/#E8C3A3; neutral #FAFAFA; redundant signed values, circle/square markers, open fills and hatch.
style: SciencePlots science/no-latex. Per user: no in-image titles, subtitles, panel headings or footnotes; scientific context in captions.

figures.question: Does one inference setting improve both directions across all splits?
figures.takeaway: Trade-offs between metrics, no universal inference improvement.
figures.scale: linear shared signed delta MRR x100

figures.question: Does the lower inverse temperature help across paired seeds and pools?
figures.family: paired delta dot plot, 2x2 metric panels, both pools per panel
figures.takeaway: 22 of 24 correlated comparisons favor beta5; EF10 exceptions remain.
figures.scale: one raw metric scale per panel for both pools, zero visible

figures.question: Do correct phase2 labels consistently beat shuffled/removed controls?
figures.takeaway: Mixed point effects; near-tie sensitivity limits interpretation.
figures.scale: shared symlog delta MRR x100, linear within +-0.001

figures.question: Does Case1 recovery improve in both candidate views?
figures.takeaway: Unique sequence recovery rises one; entry-level recovery is unchanged.
figures.scale: zero-based counts; conditional AUROC is reported in paper table/text

not_shown: Other four original figures remain in the evidence package. Their material effects are summarized in prose. Original eight-panel plots are recomposed, not shrunk to unreadable text. No results are newly evaluated.
